name: tessera_db_query
description: Read-only CLI shim for the unified tessera.duckdb store. Wraps tessera_db.py with a stable CLI: list_models returns the distinct model_hashes with per-model tensor count, family coverage, and the recommended_action distribution; list_tensor_stats returns per-tensor rows; table_names lists the tables in the DB; query runs a read-only SQL query and dumps the result rows as JSON. The Library view uses this to populate the model grid without doing directory globbing.

query.description: Which query to run. 'list_models' returns per-model rows; 'list_tensor_stats' returns per-tensor rows; 'table_names' lists the tables in the DB; 'query' runs a custom SQL query (requires --sql).

db.description: Path to the unified tessera.duckdb file.

model_hash.description: Filter (list_tensor_stats only): only return rows for this model_hash.

sql.description: Read-only SQL to run when query=query.
